text:
jamie: heads-up team — kicking off the infra change window for release/2026 in ~10m. plan: apply VPC/network modules (modules/net-*) then a separate IAM rollout for cross-account roles. will avoid any DB/schema ops. please ack if you can own the step for your area.

alex: i can own networking apply and monitor subnet/route propagation.

maria: happy to own IAM but want to run the plan and a quick audit of active external sessions before any trust updates.

sam: are we pinning the terraform aws provider this run? last time a provider bump caused drift during a canary.

jamie: yes — provider pinned to 4.2.1 in env workspaces. we have `provider \"aws\" { version = \"~> 4.2.1\" }` in the root modules.

deploy-bot: preflight start for thread=1798881234. running: `terraform plan -var-file=release-2026.tfvars --target=module.vpc,module.network`

deploy-bot: preflight: network plan OK. iam plan flagged: 1 policy trust update that overlaps with active external sessions (rule: iam-trust-overlap). recommendation: defer trust change to maintenance window.

maria: that's what i feared. can we split the run? network first, then iam in the 02:00 UTC maintenance window with PagerDuty on-call?

alex: +1 split. network changes are low-risk and unblock routing + peering for the release.

jamie: agreed. we'll apply network now (alex), verify routing + peering, and defer iam trust update to 02:00 UTC. i'll open a follow-up ticket and pin the iam plan until then.

ops-oncall: noted. i'll add the maintenance window and configure PagerDuty override for the runbook. please include rollback steps.

maria: i'll split the PR to separate trust changes from policy attachments and include verification steps for external sessions and a rollback snippet.

sam: also pls add a release-note entry: "IAM cross-account trust deferred to 02:00 UTC for safety; networking applied in daytime window."

deploy-bot: queueing network apply by alex. command:```
terraform apply -target=module.vpc -auto-approve
```

alex: starting apply now. tailing logs: `apply: 3/3 resources added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed`

alex: network apply finished. routes and peering show AVAILABLE, route tables updated.

jamie: excellent. rolling release forward without the iam trust change. maria, follow up with the pinned iam plan + rollback doc and tag ops-oncall for the night window. :thumbsup:

maria: will do. adding verification and rollback snippet:```
# rollback trust change
terraform apply -target=aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.org-assume -var-file=rollback.tfvars
```

ops-oncall: scheduled 02:00 UTC maintenance window and added PagerDuty override. reopening thread for iam at night. locking daytime change window for now. :lock:
